name: Muse Code
description: Meta's first AI coding agent launched in public beta. Terminal-based system powered by the Muse Spark 1.2 model, designed to handle large codebases and compete directly with OpenAI's Codex and Anthropic's Claude Code. Reports indicate 61-75% improvements in developer productivity.
community_quotes: Meta's first product built to visibly justify AI spending to developers
Designed for complex software development tasks, not just code completion
Cost-effective positioning against OpenAI and Anthropic
